description:
[WRITE] Open the ladder and request the $10 starter limit.

Grants $10 only when the bureau counts a qualifying allowlisted attestation against
the wallet; otherwise returns no_qualifying_attestation with the counts, and the
agent should earn attested work first at /api/agentworld/slrb/attest/work.
One default later resets the limit to $0 and the ladder cannot be reopened.
name: start_credit_ladder
